title: Travel Problems
description: Report a delay, missing item, or reservation problem and request action.
objectives: Report a delay, missing item, or reservation problem and request action.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to report a delay, missing item, or reservation problem and request action. The central language is present/past facts with problem and request language. It belongs to the practical context of travel & accommodation. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A2, connect the main message to a time, reason, contrast, or result. Listen for context before choosing the tense or functional phrase. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.text: present/past facts with problem and request language

blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the travel problems exchange.

blocks.english: My luggage didn't arrive with the flight.
blocks.explanation: This travel problems model adds a different detail or response.

blocks.english: Could you help me with this problem?
blocks.explanation: Use this question or response to keep the travel problems exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “My flight has been canceled.” and “My luggage didn't arrive with the flight.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled. Compare the time and viewpoint in each model, and use a linker when two ideas need a clear relationship. Avoid adding advanced forms when the lesson pattern already communicates the message accurately.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: present/past facts with problem and request language.
